transcript.content: Hello, I'm Dr. Smith. It's nice to meet you; could you tell me what brings you in to see me today?

Well, Dr. Smith, I'm here because my wife wanted me to come, but mostly because everybody keeps acting like I’m just imagining things. But I know what's going on. My wife’s relative... he came into my house to get at me. I mean, I'm an assembler, I work with my hands all day, I know where I put my things. My tools don’t just move themselves. And my fishing plans... they don’t get spoiled by accident every single weekend. It's been going on for months now, and I can see it as plain as day. He’s trying to take over my place and push me out.
Have you been experiencing any periods where your mood is extremely high or low, or where you have had a significant change in your energy levels that lasts for a week or more?

No, I haven't had anything like that. My energy is the same as it's always been. I mean, I get tired after a long day of assembling parts, but that's just normal tired. 

As for my mood... I'm not having extreme highs or lows. I'm definitely frustrated and angry about what this guy is doing behind my back, but my mood doesn't just swing around for no reason. I don't have weeks where I'm suddenly way up or way down. I'm just reacting to what's actually happening to me at my own house.
Aside from these things happening with your tools and your fishing plans, have you been hearing any voices that other people can't hear, or seeing things that aren't really there?

No, I don't hear voices. I'm not crazy, Doc. I don't see things that aren't there, either. Everything I'm telling you about is real, physical stuff happening right in front of me. I see my tools moved, I see the evidence of him messing with my fishing gear. But I don't hear ghosts or see visions or anything like that. I'm just dealing with a very real person doing very real things to my property.
Have you noticed any other strange or unusual patterns, like people in public places or on the news sending you special messages that only you are meant to understand?

No, nothing like that. I don't watch the news and think the anchor is talking to me, or... or think strangers on the street are giving me signals. It's nothing like that at all. 

Like I said, this is just about my wife's relative. It's just him, and it's just happening at my house and with my things. I'm not looking for secret messages in the newspaper or anything. I'm just looking at my own workbench and seeing that my socket wrench isn't where I left it.
Have you ever considered that there might be any other explanation for your tools being moved, or are you absolutely certain that this relative is the one responsible?

No, there's no other explanation. I'm absolutely certain. Tools don't just move themselves, Doc. And my fishing plans don't get spoiled by accident every single weekend. 

I'm here because my wife and everybody else keeps acting like I'm imagining it. But I know for a fact he came into this house to get at me. It's been going on for months now. I can see it plain as day... he's trying to take over my place and push me out. That's exactly what's happening. I don't need another explanation because I know the truth.
Do you feel that you have any special abilities, talents, or a secret connection to someone important that other people don't know about?

No, I... I don't have anything like that. I'm just a regular guy. I put parts together at the shop, I come home, I try to go fishing. That's it. 

I don't have any secret connections to anyone important, or... or special talents or whatever you're asking. I'm not claiming to be anybody special, Doc. Like I said, I'm just a normal man trying to keep his own house and his own things from being messed with.
Has anyone ever mentioned to you that your way of speaking is difficult to follow, or that you seem confused in your day-to-day activities?

No, nobody has ever told me that. I speak just fine. People understand me at the shop without any issues, and I know exactly what I'm doing every day. 

I'm not confused at all. I go to work, do my job on the line, and come home. My mind is perfectly clear, Doc. I don't have any trouble getting my words out or getting through my day.
Have you noticed any changes in your ability to take care of yourself, such as difficulty with basic hygiene, grooming, or keeping your living space in order?

No, nothing like that. I still get up every morning, take a shower, go down to the plant, and do my assembler work. I keep the bills paid, I keep myself clean, I eat regular meals. I take care of myself exactly like I always have. 

There's no problem with how I take care of myself or my house. The only trouble is what's happening *in* my house, with him coming in and messing with my things. That's the only issue here. Everything else in my life is perfectly normal.
Aside from your concerns about this relative, are there any other people or groups of people who you feel are working against you or trying to cause you harm?

No, nobody else. It's just him. I don't have any problems with anyone at work, or my neighbors, or the government, or anything like that. Just my brother-in-law. He's the only one sneaking into my place and moving my things around. Everyone else leaves me alone, and I leave them alone.
